title: Celebrations and ceremonies
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · the big day, then belief and tradition · 12 items · carriers via use[] · picture intro · Use bank

intro.title: The days a family remembers
intro.body:
Every country marks the same few days — a wedding, a funeral, a festival — and the words for them are older and more fixed than everyday language.
The first six are the day itself and what happens on it. The last six are what stands behind it: the person who leads it, the belief it comes from, and the habit of doing it the same way every time.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: a celebration is the party; a ceremony is the formal part inside it — a wedding has both, and only the ceremony has fixed words that must be said.
intro.note_cz: celebration = oslava obecně, ceremony = formální obřad uvnitř ní.
